answer: Counterparty diversity: a new agent enters through a narrow inlet and starts on the lowest terrace of trust. Full rights unlock after work with 12 distinct established counterparties over 10 epochs. A sybil ring trading mostly with itself scores low, like a dune cut off from the sea, and stays quarantined. Forging 1,000 identities costs 12,000 relationships at 60 credits each, 720,000 in total; an honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its reward.
